lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of circular high-luminance spots distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming a non-uniform grid posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical pale bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating faint grid-like anchor points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running longitudinally; the primary ridge shows a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density cluster of high-luminance circular spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the anterior base and the lower posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, thin, hooked foreign object (potential tag or trailing gear) is visible near the anterior insertion point of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and swimming in the immediate wake of the pelvic region.
